name: Grok Bot Usage
author: solary
description: Grok Bot weekly usage on the Omarchy bar (Grok Bot face + remaining meter, same slot as omarchy-grok-cursor-usage), with popup charts of remaining Grok Bot and Cursor Auto/API quota against even pace.

barWidget.description: Grok Bot face with a remaining meter underneath (compact by default, optional wide layout with used % · time to reset). Click for Grok Bot and Cursor remaining charts.

schema.label: Chart range
schema.description: days: 2-day window around now (same rules as omarchy-grok-cursor-usage); cycle: first sample of the period to reset.

schema.label: Wide tray
schema.description: Off: compact slot, same width as omarchy-grok-cursor-usage (face + meter). On: face + label (see Bar label), meter spans the content, with an even-pace tick.

schema.label: Bar label (wide tray)
schema.description: Wide tray only: percent-reset shows used % and time to reset, percent only used %, icon none.

schema.label: Show multi-week history
schema.description: Show the last-N-weeks remaining overlay under this week's chart. Press h in the popup to toggle it for the session.
